title: Brazil puts tokenized cows to work as loan collateral: Report
summary: Ten tokenized dairy cows backed a $19,600 loan registered on Brazil’s B3, in one of Brazil’s first uses of tokenized livestock as loan collateral.

title: Samsung Wallet plans stablecoin support in digital payments expansion
summary: Samsung Electronics plans to add stablecoin support to Samsung Wallet, expanding its mobile payments and rewards platform to include digital assets.

title: Philippine bank BPI plans stablecoin payments pilot
summary: The Philippine bank is preparing a stablecoin settlement pilot intended to speed up and reduce the cost of overseas payments to Filipino remote workers.

title: BTC supply in profit eyes 60%, but analysis hints recovery may ‘roll back over’
summary: Bitcoin supply profitability improved versus its 2026 low, but analysis warned that a fake recovery had already broken down at the start of June.

title: South Korea’s Korbit to rebrand as Digital X under Mirae: Report
summary: Mirae Asset reportedly plans to use the South Korean crypto exchange as a hub for tokenized assets, stablecoins and digital finance.

title: Ripple launches Mint to expand institutional access to RLUSD
summary: Ripple launches Mint to expand RLUSD access for institutions as the stablecoin’s market cap approaches $1.6 billion.

title: Bitcoin mining pool Poolin files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
summary: Bitcoin miner Poolin filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and initiated a $52 million sale of its two West Texas mining sites as part of its future creditor recovery program.

title: EU widens Belarus ownership ban to all crypto service providers
summary: The EU will bar Belarusian nationals and residents from owning, controlling or managing exchanges and other MiCA-regulated crypto firms from Aug. 25.

title: Bitcoin ETFs snap 7-day inflow streak with $225M in outflows
summary: After attracting nearly $1 billion over seven trading sessions, US-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded their first daily net outflow since July 13.
